ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT BYANDBETWEEN SEAPORT HEIGHTSLLC AND 80 SOUTH, LLC Dated: as of February 20, 2015 BLOCK: 72, LOT 12 and 13 NewYo-k C RECORD AND RETURN TO: KRAMER LEVIN NAFTALISANDFRANKELLLP 1177AVENUEOFTHEAMERICAS NEWYORK,NEWYORK10036 ATTENTION: PAUL D. SELVER, ESQ. KL3 2951509.16

THIS ZONING LQT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the day of February, 2015 by and between SEAPORT HEIGHTS LLC, a New York limited liability company, with an office at c/o Lam Generation LLC, 135 Grand Street, 3d Floor, New York, NY 10013 ("Owner"), and 80 SOUTH, LLC, a Delaware limited liability NewYork,NewYork 10038("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and 'improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address as 30Fletcher Street,NewYork,New York,designated as Tax Lot 12 in Block 72 particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Land", said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Owner Building," and the Owner Land and the Owner Building being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"); WHEREAS,Developer is the owner of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street addresses as 163 Front Street, designated as Tax Lot 13 in Block 72 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Developer Building,”" and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"); WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Zoning LotRestrictions of even. date and contemporaneously herewith (the“Declaration"), Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Land with the Developer Land so as to create a new, combined zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (the "Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights. (as hereinafter defined) and any Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) from the Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined) acquired by Developer for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, the parties have caused all parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot other than the Owner, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Chicago Title Insurance Company (*"Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit C to confirm the existence of the Combined Zoning Lot, to waive their right to execute any Declarations relating to any future expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot, and to subordinate their respective interest to this Agreement, as the same may be amended, by execution of a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and Subordination to Zoning LotDevelopmentAgreement; 1 KL3 2951509.16
